meta.name: ntfy
meta.shortDescription: Self-hosted push notifications: anything on your box can ping your phone
meta.longDescription: Runs your own ntfy notification server. Any pup, service or script on the box can send a push notification to your phone with one HTTP POST — pup crashes, recoveries and updates arrive automatically via the built-in health bridge. Private (token auth, deny-all by default), LAN-first, iOS + Android instant delivery.

fields.label: Server base URL
fields.name: BASE_URL
fields.help: Where phones reach this server — the address you type in the ntfy app. Use your Tailscale address (e.g. http://100.x.y.z:10011) or LAN IP (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8099). Leave empty to auto-detect from the box's IP.
